references.text: Moses also sent out spies to explore the land, and the list of their names is presented in a similar way.
Eleazar the priest and Joshua, son of Nun, are mentioned together as leaders who will distribute the land.
Eleazar the priest and Joshua, son of Nun, divide the inheritance among the children of Israel in the land of Canaan, fulfilling this verse.
Eleazar the priest and Joshua, son of Nun, completed the distribution of the land by casting lots, as commanded here.
The heads of the Levites came to Eleazar the priest and Joshua, son of Nun, to receive their cities, showing their role in the division of the land.
Eleazar's lineage and his role as a priest after Aaron are described here.
Joshua, son of Nun, is appointed as Moses' successor and shall stand before Eleazar the priest.
Joshua, son of Nun, will lead Israel into the land and distribute the inheritance to them.
